SEN.note: Only questions on personal data protection in the ID card bill debate; no data protection law stated.

facts.fact: SeneNews reports that law no. 2016-09 of 14 March 2016 establishing the ECOWAS biometric identity card is the law that bill no. 21/2026 amends, and the 2016 cards are in use.
facts.system: Law 2016-09 instituting the ECOWAS biometric identity card

facts.fact: SeneNews reports that bill no. 21/2026, amending the 2016 ECOWAS biometric identity card law to allow an exceptional extension of card validity in force majeure (article 3), was adopted in committee on 23 September 2026, returned to committee on 29 September, and its 20 November committee sitting was cancelled.

SEN.note: The cards double as voter cards, but no register keyed on the ID number is stated.
Cards issued in 2016 are named; no unique-identity issuance, biometric check or audit is stated.
